profile.headline: Scientific Applications Software Engineer at Jet Propulsion Laboratory
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the Defense & Space industry. Skilled in Python, Matlab, C++, Linux, and AWS. Strong engineering professional in hi-tech sectors with a Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering from University of Southern California.

positions.title: Scientific Applications Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software team lead, driving the development of a suite of software tools and their deployment into operational environments. Leading a team of eight software engineers, applying coding best practices (DevOps, CI/CD, version control) and managing development under a Agile/Scrum framework. Successfully led the development and delivery of data products to external partners for use in operational systems.

As an individual contributor, developed scientific data workflows modeling remote sensing image chains. Processing stages in the workflow were written in Python, Matlab, and C++. Built complex synthetic images in DIRSIG.

positions.title: Communications Systems Engineer II

Develop/Maintain data products used for operations/sustainment of space-based systems.
